_comment: Shared cross-language conformance vectors for FileId parse/render. The Rust core (tests/conformance.rs) and the Go and Java clients all run these. Encoding matches SeaweedFS exactly: the fid is {volumeId},{hex} where hex = the 12-byte big-endian buffer [needleId(8) | cookie(4)] with leading zero BYTES stripped. parse() splits the last 8 hex chars as the cookie and the remainder as the (up to 64-bit) needle key. render() is byte-stable with the server's canonical form.

valid.note: canonical server form (cookie 0x637037d6); parse->render is idempotent
non-canonical zero-padded input canonicalizes on render
needle key > 2^32 — must round-trip losslessly rather than truncate
max 64-bit needle key (24 hex chars, the upper length bound)
